name: Red Pencil / annotated frames
rationale: Original projection proof-sheet interpretation of the Red Pencil saved pin in the verified 2026-09-27 snapshot. The board was inaccessible on 2026-10-12; no new observation is claimed. Charcoal-teal stage, projector-cream type and crimson annotation rules organize a horizontal numbered navigation wall, full-width framed hero, separate metric slips, three-column roadmap, paired resource sheets and film cards, and a spacious serif logbook. All graphics are original CSS and existing SVG; no reference artwork or logos are copied.
